data.one_liner: Lightweight, customizable logger with filters, formatters and log levels
data.what_it_does: TalkerLogger provides a simple API to log messages at various levels. It supports custom formatters, color output, and filtering by log level.
use_when: logging to console in CLI or web apps
customizing log output with colors or formatters
avoid_when: production environments where logs should be sent to a remote backend
strengths: Easy to set up and use
weaknesses: No built-in UI for viewing logs
Does not send logs to external services by itself

alternatives.name: talker
alternatives.why_pick_it: Parent package that offers more features like UI and remote logging

alternatives.name: logger
alternatives.why_pick_it: Another lightweight logger with similar API
